name: Berrys AI
description: Give your agent a creative studio. Turn one product photo into on-brand listing images, campaign visuals, and short vertical videos.
author: BerryAILABS

tools.name: playground_actions_discover
tools.description: Discover implemented media editing and canvas actions. No project needed to browse; include projectId to check its permissions. By default, omit unavailable actions. Does not inspect a canvas, enable a feature, edit media or spend credits. Follow each action’s tool schema when applying it.

tools.name: playground_brands_list
tools.description: List brands owned by the connected account. Use when the user wants to choose existing brand rules. Does not select an active brand, open a project or spend credits.

tools.name: playground_brand_get
tools.description: Read the connected account’s selected brand and saved Brand DNA. Does not change the account’s active brand or apply the rules to a generation.

tools.name: playground_canvas_open
tools.description: Return the authorized project URL focused on selected node IDs. If your host has an in-app browser, open it beside chat and reuse that project tab. Otherwise show the link. This tool does not itself control a browser or prove the user is signed in.

tools.name: playground_context_current
tools.description: Use only when the user asks to work on their open project or selection. Return lightweight context from an authorized editor active in the last 2 minutes. Never choose a recent or unrelated project. General questions about Berrys do not need this tool. Does not open or render a canvas; use playground_canvas_open only when a preview is requested or needed for the task.

tools.name: playground_project_create
tools.description: Create a new, empty Playground project owned by the signed-in user. For a fresh generation request with no named, linked or conversation-established project, create one automatically with a concise name from the brief; do not ask for separate project-creation permission or inspect unrelated projects first. Reuse its ID for follow-up work on the same task. General questions do not need a project. Creation spends no credits; paid generation still requires a quote and user approval. Returns the project ID and canvasUrl.

tools.name: playground_brief_start
tools.description: Start the Berrys agent on a brief and return at once with runId and canvasUrl; it never waits. Follow it with playground_run_events (afterSeq, optionally waitSeconds) for progress, approvals and the final response, and playground_run_diagnose if it fails. projectId defaults to the project the user has open (playground_context_current). files are node IDs of uploaded media to use as references; connectorAccountIds lets the agent read connected sources (needs connector:read). Pass conversationId to continue an earlier brief. Requires agent:start; paid steps still need approval.

tools.name: playground_run_events
tools.description: Return only what changed in a run since afterSeq: compact events, a status line, pending approvals, the final response once it ends, nextAfterSeq, and retry_after_seconds (wait that long before polling again; null once the run has ended). Give runId, or conversationId for the latest run in that conversation (e.g. after reconnecting). Pass waitSeconds (up to 25) to have the server wait for new events or a status change before answering. Read-only.

tools.name: playground_run_diagnose
tools.description: One report for a run: verdict (succeeded, failed, waiting_approval, running, cancelled), the failed step, the last good step, failed media jobs with errors, and the suggested next action. Read-only.

tools.name: playground_run_steer
tools.description: Add a note to a production plan that is running: it applies to steps that have not started and later outputs are reviewed against it. Steps already generating are unchanged. Ended runs cannot be steered; send playground_brief_start with the run’s conversationId instead. Requires agent:start.

tools.name: playground_memory_proposal_review
tools.description: Approve or reject one proposed memory note for this project, as the user would in Berrys. Approved notes are read by the Berrys agent on later turns; rejected ones are archived. External apps cannot approve memory proposals; the user must review them in Berrys.

tools.name: playground_drive_image_import
tools.description: Copy one explicitly selected PNG/JPEG/WebP image (up to 8 MB) from your connected Google Drive account into Berrys reference storage, where generation providers can fetch it. Returns a File nodeId: pass it in referenceNodeIds to use it. Requires a connected Drive account belonging to this Berrys user; another agent’s Drive connection is not inherited. Free; no generation starts. Never accepts credentials or a sharing-page URL.

tools.name: playground_video_extract_frames
tools.description: Extract frames from a Playground clip

tools.name: playground_media_compose
tools.description: Assemble Playground clips into one film

tools.name: playground_video_trim
tools.description: Trim a Playground clip

tools.name: playground_media_compare
tools.description: Compare 2–4 images or 2–4 videos side by side on the canvas. Two images fill a Compare (image-compare) node\

tools.name: playground_video_analyze
tools.description: Read-only facts about one video node: its clip URL, model and settings, frame nodes already taken from it, objective FFmpeg measurements (duration, black segments, silence, loudness) when the server has FFmpeg, and any visual analysis the Berrys agent already made of this exact clip. It never makes a new paid model call, so a new shot table or visual description is not produced here; ask the Berrys agent (playground_brief_start) for that.

tools.name: playground_asset_import
tools.description: Download one public HTTPS image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, ≤8 MB), video (MP4, ≤16 MB) or audio file (MP3 or WAV, ≤12 MB), check its bytes, copy it into project storage, and add it as a file node that can feed image and video generation. Private, local and internal addresses are refused, and every redirect is rechecked. Free; revision checked and idempotent.

tools.name: playground_node_run
tools.description: Run the generation already configured on 1–20 existing image, video or audio nodes. Image: prompt (its Text node), modelId, aspectRatio, wired references. Video: instructions, modelId, aspectRatio, duration, wired references and first/last frames. Audio: the node\

tools.name: playground_media_generate
tools.description: Batch-generate 1–20 images, videos or audio tracks (FLORA-style). Each image/video item becomes a new node, with its prompt Text node and wired referenceNodeIds; each audio item becomes an audio node holding its words (prompt), modelId (default minimax:speech-2.8-hd), voice or style. Nodes are placed in free space in one revision-checked canvas edit, then run like playground_node_run. quote: true validates references, saves a ten-minute quoteId, prices every item and changes no canvas nodes; execution requires that quoteId (canvas:read). Otherwise it needs media:spend; every paid request returns approval_required for the user to confirm in their agent chat. A retried idempotencyKey never creates or charges twice.

tools.name: playground_content_prepare
tools.description: The easiest way to start making content. Give a short brief and the images, clips or audio needed; intendedUse is optional. Berrys turns this into explicit prompts and an exact, free credit quote in one call. It does not create nodes or spend credits. For a new creative task, create a fresh project first with playground_project_create; for a follow-up, reuse its projectId. Import any uploaded or linked image to that project first and pass its image node ID as a reference. Audio needs the exact spoken words or lyrics. Review the returned prompts, references, defaults and price with the user; the returned mediaGenerateRequest is the exact input for playground_media_generate with quoteId and a new idempotencyKey when they want to proceed.

tools.name: playground_media_retry_quote
tools.description: Read fresh receipts for one run and quote replacements only for confirmed failed items, including individual List outputs. Completed, pending, active, uncertain and changed-reference items are excluded. Optional dispatchIds selects failed items explicitly. Quote only: no canvas edit, approval or generation. Returns exact retryPlan.items and quoteId for playground_media_generate; user confirmation is still required before spending.

tools.name: playground_skills_discover
tools.description: Explore built-in playbooks without opening or creating a project. Search by query/category and follow nextOffset. Include projectId only to include that project’s private skills after an access check. Skills teach a method; they do not grant permissions or spend credits.

tools.name: playground_skill_load
tools.description: Load exact versioned instructions. Built-in skills need no projectId. Private project skills require projectId and scope: project, with current read access. Does not generate media or grant permissions.

tools.name: playground_workflow_search
tools.description: Find accessible saved project workflows by name. Returns workflow IDs for inspection and staged execution. This does not search public templates.

tools.name: playground_workflow_inspect
tools.description: Read typed source input contracts, generation dependencies, completed outputs, pending/active work and blockers. Returns the next ready stage without spending. Use before running a saved campaign.

tools.name: playground_workflow_inputs_set
tools.description: Save text/List inputs, prompts, formats, durations, audio settings and image reference choices from workflow_inspect. Free, atomic, revision checked and idempotent. Completed, active and approved steps are read-only, including their shared inputs. Does not generate or approve anything. Returns the refreshed workflow form. Upload new reference media first; choose its existing node ID.

tools.name: playground_workflow_quote
tools.description: Quote only the next ready empty steps from workflow_inspect, up to 20 outputs. Does not edit the canvas, prepare approval or submit generation. Safe for the chat workflow form. Returns the exact stageNodeIds, revision and quoteId for a later chat-confirmed playground_workflow_run request.

tools.name: playground_workflow_run
tools.description: Run a saved workflow through its ready image/video/audio stages. quote:true prices up to 20 ready nodes including connected List batches. Pass the returned stageNodeIds, expectedRevision, quoteId and a NEW idempotencyKey with quote:false to prepare chat confirmation. Does not auto-approve or dispatch dependent stages. After existing jobs settle, inspect/quote the next stage until completed. Preserve completed, active and uncertain work; no Berrys-agent delegation is needed.
